terra.problem: The claim that the Philistines have troubled Israel for a long time needs a reference outside this passage. 'Here they come again' also suggests they started this war, which the text does not say.
The uninvited-party joke puts down the Philistines as a group.
The statement that Moab is Israel's neighbor needs a reference outside this passage.
The statement that the Edomites are Israel's neighbors needs a reference outside this passage.
The passage does not call the Rephaim a family known for great stature, or say that the battle turned when Sippai fell.
Papa says he knows the statement sounded like a trick to the baker, though he has not been told that.
The passage does not say whether rewards were handed out. Their being subdued does not establish that none were.
'Family name' and the claim that appearances never end well for the family go beyond what the passage says.
The explanation that Gittite means Goliath was from Gath needs a reference outside this passage.
The text identifies Goliath as Lahmi's brother, but does not explicitly say Og was not also his brother.
Neither cited passage establishes that Sisera had nothing to do with Lahmi's family or that the events were in different centuries.
'Wrong battle, wrong century' uses 'wrong' to describe the baker's answer.
The handshake joke makes the man's physical appearance the punchline.
The joke does not make sense as stated: Papa's mustache is part of him, so using it would not mean borrowing it from someone else.
The last line makes the man's physical features the subject of a joke.
The passage does not say all these battles happened under David's leadership.
The statement that David is king of Israel needs a reference outside this passage.
Saying the king got the credit while his team did the fighting implies David did not take part. The text says the descendants fell at the hands of David and his servants.
The statements about Saul being Israel's first king and his reign being over need a reference outside this passage.
The passage does not say there were no priests present or that they were handling other business.
